interpretations: Average constructorStandings points and wins per circuit country, averaged over all constructor-standing rows (each constructor at each race) at races held in that country. The deviation is each country's average wins minus the mean of the country-level average wins (an unweighted mean across countries).
Same as 1, but the deviation is measured against the overall average wins across all constructor-standing rows (a row-weighted global average), not the mean of the country averages.

Same as 1, but the averages are computed per race first (the average across constructors in each race) and then averaged across the races in each country. The deviation is against the mean of the country figures.

Average points and wins per country using only each constructor's final standing in each season (the last race of the season) at races held in that country. The deviation is against the mean of the country averages.
Average points and wins per country using only the standings of the constructors in first place (the leader) after each race held there. The deviation is against the mean of the country averages.

Average points and wins per country computed per constructor (each constructor's average across its races in that country), then averaged across constructors. The deviation is against the mean of the country averages.
The deviation is reported as a signed difference (country average wins − mean of country average wins), positive above and negative below.
The deviation is reported as an absolute difference (magnitude only).
The deviation is reported as a percentage or ratio relative to the mean of the country averages.
Country is taken from circuits.country, linked through races.circuitId, and countries with no races or standings are excluded.
Countries with no constructor-standing records are included, with null or zero averages.
"Average of the country figures" refers to the average of the countries' average wins only, not of points.
"Average of the country figures" refers to the average of both the points and wins averages, giving a separate deviation for each.
Output includes only country, average points, average wins, and the wins deviation.
Output also includes the number of races or standing records per country.
Missing interpretations:

Averages are computed per season first (the average across a country's seasons), then averaged across seasons, with the deviation against the mean of the country averages.
Averages are weighted by the number of races per country, with the deviation against a race-weighted overall average.
Deviation is measured against the median of the country averages instead of the mean.
Country grouping uses races.name (the Grand Prix name) or circuits.location instead of circuits.country.
Averages are computed only for a single constructor, or only for the top-ranked constructors, at races held in each country.

queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT ci.country AS country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId
  GROUP BY ci.country
)
SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins,
       avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM c) AS deviation
FROM c;
SELECT c.nationality,
       AVG(cs.wins) - (SELECT AVG(wins) FROM constructorStandings) AS deviation
FROM constructorStandings cs
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality;
WITH race_avg AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, ci.country, AVG(cr.points) AS race_avg_points
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, ci.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_points) AS avg_points
  FROM race_avg
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM country_avg) AS deviation
FROM country_avg;
WITH last_race AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.circuitId
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.round = (SELECT MAX(r2.round) FROM races r2 WHERE r2.year = r.year)
),
final_standings AS (
  SELECT c.country, cs.points, cs.wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN last_race lr ON lr.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = lr.circuitId
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM final_standings
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM country_avg) AS points_deviation,
       avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_deviation
FROM country_avg;
WITH country_avg AS (
  SELECT c.country,
         AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE cs.position = 1
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM country_avg) AS points_deviation,
       avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_deviation
FROM country_avg;
WITH per_constructor AS (
  SELECT c.country AS country,
         cs.constructorId AS constructorId,
         AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country, cs.constructorId
),
per_country AS (
  SELECT country,
         AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM per_constructor
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM per_country) AS points_deviation,
       avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM per_country) AS wins_deviation
FROM per_country;
